_about: Synthesize prompt texts and limits, read by knowledge/synth.py and the phone (web/src/mobile/ai/synth.ts). Placeholders are {name}. One source is its title line, the meta lines (creator, url, tags, category) and its labelled parts (part_order, each cut to limits.parts, then the trim_order parts cut until all fit limits.excerpt_limit). tests/test_phone_ai.py checks both sides build the same prompts.
rules:
Rules:
- Write clean markdown with descriptive ## / ### titles and short paragraphs, so the note is easy to navigate later.
- Capture every tool, app, product, website, book, channel, or other resource mentioned in the sources under a '## Tools & resources mentioned' section; for each, note what it is and the source id(s) it came from, and keep any URLs.
- Keep a '## Sources' section at the end listing the source ids you used.
- Be specific; do not invent facts beyond the sources.
- Each source's text comes in labelled parts (Report, AI description, Transcript, Caption, My note); 'My note' is what the owner wrote about the source and may hold their own view: keep it apart from what the source itself says.
- Return the COMPLETE note as markdown only — no preamble, no commentary, no code fences.
